features: Pan 360 deg continuous, tilt 18 deg above horizon
Variable speed 0.1-120 deg/s; preset speed pan 360 deg/s, tilt 100 deg/s
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (AutoDome_800_Data_sheet_enUS_9007201729491595.pdf). Outdoor pendant housing with sunshield (converts to indoor pendant by removing sunshield). ECEV = clear bubble, ETEV = tinted bubble (tinted adds 0.8 f-stop loss). Sensitivity at 30 IRE, SensUP off: day 0.8 lx, night mode 0.12 lx. Weight is outdoor pendant (indoor pendant 2.88 kg). Consumption 55 W typical with heater (19 W without). The datasheet lists VG5-836-ECEV (separate record) with the same description; the difference between the 825 and 836 SKUs is not stated.

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
